## Objective

Run nonlinear geometry, patch/operator, inversion, serialization, concurrency and failure contracts on JVM and JS/fullOpt. Verify public error/capability boundaries and exact dependency closure; rerun affected existing consumers.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 13, 14, FA-11N. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `JVM/JS/fullOpt nonlinear suites`
- `POM and consumer evidence`

## Acceptance criteria

1. All applicable numerical/typed/platform gates pass with exact source/provider hashes.
2. No public mutable alias, unchecked owner cast, fabricated inverse, or shared filesystem/thread type is introduced.
3. Existing motion/HalfFlow and core/resample behavior remains qualified; experimental publication state is reported independently.

## Blocking prerequisites

- N13 (`bd-01M2B1197EC52V246FWZBHTB5Y`): FA-N13: Implement nonlinear records, inverse evidence and bounded output
- N12 (`bd-01M2B1192ZZM2W6AFM0DKG4729`): FA-N12: Implement information-supported model selection and nonlinear QC
- L21 (`bd-01M2B1176364H28NG1DD0K11Q5`): FA-L21: Qualify the complete linear API across JVM and Scala.js

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
